concepts.title: Area of a Parallelogram
concepts.definition: Area of a parallelogram = base x height. Any side can be the base; the perpendicular from the opposite side is the height.
concepts.formula: Area = base x height = b x h
concepts.key_idea: Area of parallelogram = base x height.
question_patterns: find the area of the parallelogram
find height if area and base given
find base if area and height given
two sides of parallelogram find area

solution_steps.explain: Base is any side, height is perpendicular to it

concepts.title: Area of a Triangle
concepts.definition: Area of a triangle = (1/2) x base x height. A triangle is half of a parallelogram with the same base and height.
concepts.key_idea: Area of triangle = half of base x height.
question_patterns: find the area of the triangle
find base if area and height given
find height if area and base given
find bc if area and height given
find qm if area and base given
triangle abc right angled find area and ad

solution_steps.explain: Base is any side, height is perpendicular to it (may be outside for obtuse)

concepts.title: Circumference of a Circle
concepts.definition: Circumference of a circle = pi x diameter = 2 x pi x radius. pi = 22/7 or 3.14. The ratio of circumference to diameter is constant (pi).
concepts.formula: C = pi x d = 2 x pi x r; pi = 22/7 or 3.14
concepts.key_idea: Circumference = 2 x pi x r = pi x d.
question_patterns: length of tape to wrap around pipe
wire bent into circle find radius
minute hand tip move in 1 hour

solution_steps.explain: Radius or diameter? Use pi = 22/7 or 3.14 as specified
Circumference of semicircle = (1/2) x pi x d. Perimeter of semicircular disc = pi x r + 2 x r (includes diameter)

concepts.title: Area of a Circle
concepts.definition: Area of a circle = pi x r^2 where r is the radius. pi = 22/7 or 3.14.
concepts.formula: Area = pi x r^2; pi = 22/7 or 3.14
concepts.key_idea: Area of circle = pi x r squared.
question_patterns: find the area of the circle
circle cut from square find remaining
circular card sheet with removed circles

solution_steps.explain: Radius or diameter? Use pi = 22/7 or 3.14
r = C / (2 x pi), then Area = pi x r^2
shaded area = area of larger - area of smaller

concepts.title: Applications of Perimeter and Area
concepts.definition: Apply perimeter and area formulas to solve real-world problems: fencing, polishing, cost calculations, comparing shapes.
concepts.formula: cost = rate x area or rate x perimeter
concepts.key_idea: Apply formulas to real situations with cost calculations.
question_patterns: compare area of circle and square

solution_steps.explain: Use appropriate perimeter or area formula
cost = rate x quantity (perimeter or area)
